rule: Transfer test of the FROZEN General AC-MOT G1 candidate to a detector family never used in the project. Nothing in G1 (research/GENERAL_ACMOT_G1_LOCK.json) or in V7f (research/V7_POLICY_LOCK.json) may change for this detector, before or after seeing results; the result is reported once, as obtained. Only the detector adapter (API translation) is new.

candidate.name: General AC-MOT G1
candidate.system: V7f+MEDIUM (= 736 px via the shared profile)

detector.name: RetinaNet ResNet50-FPN v2 (torchvision, COCO)
detector.cache_recipe: tools/sci_v7/build_sweep_cache.py: score floor 0.01, detector-native NMS (0.5), detections_per_img 1000, longest side 640 / 736 / 832 px, COCO person/car/bus/truck
detector.profile: shared profile (configs/sci_v7_profiles.json unseen_detector_rule): MEDIUM = 736 px; no per-detector calibration

data: VisDrone2019-MOT-val, 7 sequences (development split, row P6). No other split.

hosts.botsort: same thresholds, sparse optical-flow GMC, no ReID, real frames (GitHub Actions)

evaluation: internal protocol (tools/seqstats.py; HOTA TrackEval 12c8791, motmetrics 1.4.0) primary; official-compatible protocol (tools/v6/eval_official.py) reported; paired sequence bootstrap of tools/v7/bootstrap.py (10,000 resamples, seed 42)

predictions.P1: With ByteTrack, G1 - NATIVE HOTA >= 0 (point estimate).
predictions.P2: G1 adds no catastrophic sequence (MOTA < 0) relative to NATIVE for any host.
predictions.P3: No prediction on the size of the gain: RetinaNet's score calibration was never seen.
